lines.text: She called me out for being late.

data.define: To say publicly that someone did something wrong.

example.text: She called me out for being late.

misuse.text: Don't 'call out' a coworker in front of the boss.

native.tip: “call out” = ينتقد علنًا; يُشير إلى الخطأ. مثال: “She called me out for being late.”
native.caption:
ما معنى “call out”؟
“call out” = ينتقد علنًا; يُشير إلى الخطأ.
مثال: “She called me out for being late.” (لقد "called me out" بسبب تأخري.)
